tasks.title: Task 1: Replace Dashboard page in src/manifest.json
acceptance_criteria: Replace the `"id": "Dashboard"` page entry in `src/manifest.json` with the exact JSON from design.md (Target Manifest section); verify JSON is valid after edit
Confirm `widgets[]` has 12 entries (11 custom + 1 stats-block), `layout[]` has 11 entries (10 custom in layout + 1 stats-block; `dashboard-empty-state` absent from layout), and `slots` has 11 entries
Confirm `active-decisions` is `type: "custom"` with slot `widget-active-decisions` → `ActiveDecisionsKpiWidget`; no `dataSource` block; `showTitle: false`
Confirm `minutes-in-review` is `type: "stats-block"`, English title "Minutes awaiting approval", `showTitle: true`
Confirm `published-decisions` and `open-action-items` are removed; `dashboard-empty-state` is in `widgets[]` + `slots` but NOT in `layout[]`

tasks.title: Task 2: Wire DashboardEmptyState conditional in dashboard page component
acceptance_criteria: Identify where the Dashboard page component lives (check `src/views/Dashboard.vue` or `src/views/DashboardPage.vue`; if absent, determine whether a CnPageRenderer override component is needed)

Add ≤8 LOC: after governance body collection fetch resolves, if `governanceBodies.length === 0` swap the active layout to show `dashboard-empty-state` full-width and hide other layout items (or use a flag toggling between `emptyLayout` and `fullLayout`)
tasks.notes: Manifest declaration (widgets[]+slots, excluded from layout[]) done; runtime empty-state swap deferred per design.md — no dashboard host component exists (fully manifest-driven), and a host would break the verbatim-manifest + ADR-032 ≤8-LOC/≤1-file budget.
